crossRefs.note: Yahweh sent Jerubbaal, Bedan, Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side…

people.name: Bedan
people.line: A descendant of Manasseh through Machir and Gilead.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Son of Machir; grandson of Manasseh; father of six sons.

people.name: Machir
people.line: Son of Manasseh; father (ie re-founder) of Gilead

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Ulam
people.line: Son of Sheresh, great-grandson of Manasseh

translations.web: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
translations.bsb: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
translations.asv: And the sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
